<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110‑160 ppm) are at 160.80, 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm. That corresponds to seven distinct aromatic carbon signals, indicating the molecule contains seven aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
